items.title: sync-api: the sign-in store layer (migration 4, hand-off store, sweep, revoke rule) with its tests
items.red_not_run: the production code and its tests land together: on the base the tests do not compile (the types are absent), so there is no assertion-red leg; the mutants carry the proof

expected_red: five live codes then a sixth displaces the oldest and no other
entries.rule: the cap raised to six: the sixth start displaces nothing

expected_red: five live codes then a sixth displaces the oldest and no other
entries.rule: the cap check off by one: at five live codes nothing is displaced

edits.anchor: "ORDER BY created_at_ms ASC, rowid ASC LIMIT ?)"
edits.replacement: "ORDER BY created_at_ms DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT ?)"

expected_red: five live codes then a sixth displaces the oldest and no other
entries.rule: the newest code is displaced instead of the oldest

edits.anchor: "ORDER BY created_at_ms ASC, rowid ASC LIMIT ?)"
edits.replacement: "ORDER BY created_at_ms ASC, rowid DESC LIMIT ?)"

expected_red: with equal times the row written first is the oldest and is the one displaced
entries.rule: the tie of equal times displaces the later row

expected_red: a row gets the created time now and an expiry exactly five minutes later
entries.rule: the code lifetime six minutes

edits.replacement: "SELECT account_id, challenge, package FROM signin_handoff WHERE code_hash = ? AND expires_at_ms >= ?"

expected_red: a code is dead at the instant of its expiry
entries.rule: a code still redeems at its expiry instant

edits.replacement: private const val DELETE_EXPIRED_SQL = "DELETE FROM signin_handoff WHERE expires_at_ms < ?"

expected_red: deleteExpired removes a row dead at its expiry and keeps one a millisecond younger
entries.rule: the sweep keeps a row dead at its expiry instant

expected_red: a wrong secret is Refused and the same code then redeems with the right secret
entries.rule: the secret compare skipped: a wrong secret redeems
equivalent: same result for the same bytes; constant-time behaviour cannot be observed by a test

edits.replacement: private const val DELETE_ROW_SQL = "DELETE FROM signin_handoff WHERE code_hash = ? AND 0"

expected_red: a second redeem of the same code is Refused
entries.rule: the row is not deleted at the exchange and the exchange does not notice: a code redeems twice

expected_red: expired rows are gone after the next start and a live row stays

entries.rule: the account check skipped: the insert fails the foreign key instead of answering NoSuchAccount

edits.replacement: const val DELETE_ACCOUNT_HANDOFF_SQL = "DELETE FROM signin_handoff WHERE account_id = ? OR 1"

expected_red: revokeAllForAccount deletes every signin_handoff row of that account and leaves another account's
entries.rule: the revoke deletes every account's codes

expected_red: revokeOtherSessions keeps one session revokes the other and deletes all handoff rows
entries.rule: the kept session is the only one revoked

expected_red: the sweep interval constant is 60 seconds
entries.rule: the sweep interval 30 seconds

expected_red: runHandoffSweep first sweep runs before the first pause and passes the 60 second interval
entries.rule: no boot sweep: the loop waits before its first sweep

expected_red: runHandoffSweep a failing sweep over a closed database is swallowed and pause is still called
entries.rule: a failing sweep ends the loop

expected_red: stop sweep runs between stop internal and close database
entries.rule: shutdown no longer stops the sweep

expected_red: a hand-off package of 112 bytes is refused and 113 are accepted
entries.rule: the package length check 114

expected_red: a hand-off challenge of 42 characters is refused and 43 are accepted
entries.rule: the challenge length check 44
